item.title: Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer
item.summary: Content Warning: This post discusses suicide. ———————————————————————————————————————————————— Friday morning, August 14, 2026, I received this text from a number I didn’t recognize: “ALERT! Dear Amazonians, GREF has temporarily closed the building for today. You are welcome to work from BOS17 until further notice." I thought the text was odd but I confirmed it was legitimate and continued my day working remotely. My team had our daily standup and everything seemed quite normal, until 3:00 PM when I received this canned email from HR: “This morning we closed BOS21 following the tragic loss of one of our Amazon colleagues….” [1] What that email didn’t mention was that this colleague died by suicide. Learning that was surreal… I’ve been working professionally for over a decade and this is the first time I’ve encountered a workplace tragedy like this. I didn’t know what to expect. Later that afternoon there were many positive messages in BOS21’s Slack channel, colleagues offering an open ear and providing links to emergency resources. That was reassuring.
